posts.title: CLN Developer Series #7: Post-Release Deprecations
posts.description: After each release, we remove the features and options which were EOL in the previous one (we give one release during which features can be re-enabled by the i-promise-to-fix-broken-api-user option).

posts.title: CLN Developer Series #6: Neatening a Bugfix PR
posts.description: This is an “eat your veggies!” talk, which is an indepth review of an excellent PR by @dovgopoly. When someone first submits a PR, I like to explain every detail of how I would have done it, so they have some guidance about what the process looks like.

posts.title: CLN Developer Series #5: Gossipd: The Gossip Daemon
posts.description: After the previous aside on a gossip bug, I realized I should do a tour of each daemon. I started with gossipd because it’s my favorite, having changed so much from what it originally did into something which now mainly exports the “gossip_store” file for other subdaemons and plugins to use.
